items.title: Ransomware Gang Goes Full 'Godfather' With Cartel
items.description: Since its launch in 2023, DragonForce has pushed a cartel model, emphasizing cooperation and coordination among ransomware gangs.

items.title: CISA Makes Unpublicized Ransomware Updates to KEV Catalog
items.description: A third of the "flipped" CVEs affected network edge devices, leading one researcher to conclude, "Ransomware operators are building playbooks around your perimeter."

items.title: Critical n8n flaws disclosed along with public exploits
items.description: Multiple critical vulnerabilities in the popular n8n open-source workflow automation platform allow escaping the confines of the environment and taking complete control of the host server. [...]

items.title: Attackers Use Windows Screensavers to Drop Malware, RMM Tools
items.description: By tapping the unusual .scr file type, attackers leverage "executables that don't always receive executable-level controls," one researcher noted.

items.title: Microsoft Develops Scanner to Detect Backdoors in Open-Weight Large Language Models
items.description: Microsoft on Wednesday said it built a lightweight scanner that it said can detect backdoors in open-weight large language models (LLMs) and improve the overall trust in artificial intelligence (AI) systems. The tech giant's AI Security team said the scanner leverages three observable signals that can be used to reliably flag the presence of backdoors while maintaining a low false positive
